stories.headline: Achane's Wagon Throws a Wheel - Season's Over, Miami's Backfield Wide Open
stories.read: Well pardner, hate to be the one to tell ya: De'Von Achane went down with a torn ACL against the Chiefs, and his season's done, dry as an empty well. That's the richest vein sittin' out on the open range all year. Jaylen Wright's stepped up as the lead horse in Miami's stable, with Ollie Gordon saddled up right behind him as the spare. If you've got a waiver claim burnin' a hole in your pocket, Wright's the one to stake first thing tomorrow, before the rest of the outfit rides in.

stories.headline: Commanders Ridin' Blind - Daniels AND McLaurin Both Laid Up for the Falcons Showdown
stories.read: Jayden Daniels is out again with that bum knee, and word from the ranch is Terry McLaurin's quad has him seekin' second opinions - that's a fella nursin' somethin' worse than first let on. Marcus Mariota's back under center against Atlanta, and every Commanders pass-catcher just took a hit to his ceiling with a backup gunslinger and the outfit's top target both off the trail. Doc's read: bench what you can, and don't go chasin' this offense for points till the docs clear both of 'em.

stories.headline: Jefferson Takes a Spill - Vikings' Ace Uncertain for the Miami Showdown
stories.read: Justin Jefferson took a tumble against the Bucs Sunday and never got back on the field with that ankle, though word is he came awful close to ridin' back in. He's a coin-flip at best for the Dolphins tilt, and that's fresh gold for Jordan Addison to pan - the fella already put up five catches, ninety yards, and a touchdown while Jefferson was laid up. Stake an early claim on Addison before the saloon catches wise, and keep one eye on the practice report before you trust Jefferson in your lineup.
